title: Gekkan Shoujo Nozaki-kun Mini OVAs
justification: AniList: 6 shorts of 3 min, 2014-09-24 to 2015-02-25. AniDB 10542 S1-S6 are six shorts on exactly those dates (S7 "Advance Screening and Talk Show", 2014-10-29, is a different kind and is not in the run). TVDB 279804 season 0 holds the same six, 0x1-0x6 "Nozaki-kun Shorts 1-6": 1 "Is That Handsome Boy Just a Friend or Her Boyfriend? (Part 1)" = S1; 2 "(Part 2)" = S2 "...Continued"; 3 "The Correlation Chart That Connects Everything" = S3 "A Comprehensive Relationship Chart"; 4 "It's Summer! It's the Ocean! It's Training Camp!" = S4; 5 "Me or the Sun... Which Do You Think Shines More?" = S5; 6 "This Happening is Being Turned Into a Shojo Manga" = S6. Same order, dates equal on all six (2014-09-24 ... 2015-02-25). The parent has no mapping list so S<n> defaults to 0x<n>; no other node on 279804 claims season 0. The AniList title ("Mini OVAs") names the series only, the episode titles are AniDB's.
